scope: Read-only local source and tool inventory analysis. No build, container, chroot, namespace, mount or compiler probe was executed.

findings.detail: The macro reads cargo metadata, extracts absolute path+file package IDs and emits them as ordinary Rust string literals. It also separately reads Components.toml from actual metadata.workspace_root.

init_component emits file!() into ComponentRegistry. Runtime strips src/ or tests/ and uses exact key removal from a map keyed by metadata-derived package path. Remapping only file! paths can separate the keys; no runtime panic was newly tested.

OSDK BuildScheme exposes profile/features/rustflags etc.; no virtual Cargo metadata workspace root. OSDK canonicalizes source/config paths. Rustflags support does not rewrite arbitrary macro-generated literals.

build_kernel_elf overwrites OSDK_BUILD_USERNAME and OSDK_BUILD_HOSTNAME with whoami values for the child cargo process. Parent values and USER/HOSTNAME are insufficient. Cached whoami 1.6.1 uses getpwuid_r/gethostname on Linux.

Generated base Cargo.toml starts with empty [workspace], and core is a path dependency. RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER is scoped to workspace members and cannot be relied on to intercept core and all dependencies. It does not virtualize metadata subprocesses.

bwrap 0.9.0 exists but permission for its required namespaces/mounts was not probed. Docker/Podman/Nix/PRoot were not found on PATH. chroot does not itself change the UTS hostname or supply a complete root filesystem.

routes.name: canonical real build root
routes.claim_scope: Normalize different origin checkouts into the same actual canonical compiler-visible source/tool/cache/target paths; still same-visible-path compilation. Does not prove cross-visible-path or cross-host output identity.
requirements: git detached worktree or exact committed snapshot at a reserved real absolute path
serialize access and validate ownership; never delete arbitrary supplied target/source directories
fixed real toolchain/Cargo source/VDSO paths, not merely symlink aliases
fixed timestamp/timezone/locale and complete input hashes
clean target before each run with before/after identity receipts
record actual host username/nodename; cannot neutralize them by only exporting parent OSDK_BUILD_* variables

routes.name: existing image/engine fixed mount root
routes.claim_scope: Distinct origin host paths bind to one compiler-visible root. If executed on distinct hosts, can test a defined normalized-environment cross-host property; does not test arbitrary compiler-visible roots.
requirements: digest-pinned image and complete tools/dependency hashes
same fixed mount roots for source, toolchain, cargo registry and target
stable container identity/hostname and build account
no privileged host network or host /dev passthrough needed for this TCG boot profile
actual independent job/host identity receipts and bytewise output comparison

routes.name: RUSTC_WRAPPER normalization
routes.status: candidate requiring design and real tests
routes.claim_scope: An all-rustc wrapper could select explicitly recorded embedded builder identity without changing SDK source, but it cannot fix Cargo metadata package path literals or provide cross-host evidence.
limitations: all-rustc wrapper must preserve argv exactly and compose safely with existing wrappers
must handle Cargo environment dependency fingerprints correctly; clean-only success is insufficient incremental evidence
actual host identity must remain in external provenance even if embedded builder identity is normalized

coordination_proposals.change: Use a shared stable component package identity instead of absolute package path + file! registration. CARGO_PKG_NAME is a candidate only with an explicit uniqueness check consistent with Components.toml; otherwise use a structured stable package identity. Keep graph priorities and stage ordering unchanged.
validation: macro/host coverage for duplicate identities, dependency graph and equal priorities
two different real source roots, empty target, identical tool/cache/host identities
all declared component initialization stages and actual boot validation on both artifacts
bytewise ELF comparison and PT_LOAD/rodata root audit
normal full kernel and OSTD/core regressions

coordination_proposals.change: Optionally honor explicitly supplied reproducible embedded builder username/hostname with the current whoami behavior as default. Record selected and actual identities separately. No version/pin replacement.
validation: explicit fixed identities reach actual core rustc and /proc/version
actual independent-host clean build pair; compare all outputs and provenance
